cells.gaps: No delivery plan with dated actions or costs, and no results against the Master Plan's targets, have been found. The National Digital Roadmap 2026-2030 is being formulated (ZWE-001) and is not yet adopted. The body the Master Plan mandates is dated 2019, outside the 36-month window.
cells.note: The Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan was launched by the ICT minister on 7 March 2024, its text is published by the ministry and its period runs to 2030: rung 3. The roadmap now being drafted is a successor in preparation and does not unseat an adopted strategy still in its period.
